maria gomez: Quick question — we're onboarding an external audit contractor next week who only needs read-only Console access to Cloud logs for project `redwood-analytics` for a 48h window. Need least-privilege pattern. They must NOT see billing or Secret Manager. @noah any quick rec? :eyes:
noah lee: Short answer: use a scoped principal with logging-only privileges and time-bounded access. `roles/logging.viewer` at project scope covers logs but watch for sensitive fields inside logs. Prefer a SA with an IAM Condition limiting `request.time` for 48h rather than permanent user binding.
sara kim: Also flag: our logs sometimes contain user emails/PII. If you can't sanitize upstream, consider creating a duplicate "sanitized-logs" project and stream only safe sinks there. That's what we do for third-parties.
jen o'neill: If it's faster, we can add the contractor to a Workspace group with membership expiry (48h) and bind `roles/logging.viewer` to that group at the project level. Confirmed that group's binding won't give Secret Manager or billing by default. Remember to add an org-level deny for `secretmanager.versions.access` if you want extra protection. :lock:
noah lee: Example approach I'll draft: 1) create SA `audit-ext-47@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com` 2) grant `roles/logging.viewer` on `projects/redwood-analytics` 3) add IAM Condition restricting time window e.g. `request.time >= timestamp("2026-05-01T00:00:00Z") && request.time <= timestamp("2026-05-03T00:00:00Z")` 4) rotate/disable keys after window, or prefer no long-lived keys (use Workload Identity). I'll open a PR with the bindings and the condition.
noah lee: Quick note: if you need Console UI (not just API) ensure the principal has `roles/browser` or `roles/viewer` but that expands visibility. If UI is required, prefer the Workspace group JIT path.
deploy-bot: Access request created: IR-2026-2417 — https://infra.redwood/internal/ir/IR-2026-2417 (owner: noah lee)
maria gomez: Thanks — appreciated. I'll wait for the PR and the IR link. Can someone review the policy before we apply? :thumbsup:
